float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: GNU Radio takes cos and sin from its 10 bit fxpt table (measured worst 1.4 LSB, 92 dB); the float instance evaluates them exactly

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Phase rounded to 12 table bits: error at most pi/4096 rad = 25.1 LSB at amplitude 1, plus up to 1.5 LSB from table amplitude 2^15-1 and quantisation; rms phase error 2*pi/4096/sqrt(12) -> 67.1 dB (measured 25.4 LSB, 67.1 dB)
Phase rounded to 14 table bits: error at most pi/16384 rad = 6.3 LSB at amplitude 1, plus the amplitude 2^17-1 and quantisation; rms -> 79.1 dB (measured 6.4 LSB, 79.1 dB)
